skill.displayName: FireRed Image Edit – Open Source AI Image Editing Model for High Fidelity Edits – API-powered
skill.summary: FireRed image editor — edit or generate images with high fidelity using FireRed open-source model

latestVersion.changelog:
FireRed image editor skill — initial release.

- Edit or generate images with high fidelity using the open-source FireRed model.
- Supports up to 3 reference images and customizable aspect ratios.
- Requires an API key set as the WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable for secure access.
- Three main endpoints: start runs, poll status, and upload images.
- Provides batch generation and flexible output parameters.
